title: stays logged out when there is no token
fullName: auth session stays logged out when there is no token
source:
it('stays logged out when there is no token', async () => {
    getToken.mockReturnValue(null)
    await expect(loadMe()).resolves.toBeNull()
    expect(auth.loaded).toBe(true)
    expect(api).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
    expect(hasRole('user')).toBe(false)
    expect(can('room:read')).toBe(false)
  })

title: drops a token that the server no longer accepts
fullName: auth session drops a token that the server no longer accepts
source:
it('drops a token that the server no longer accepts', async () => {
    getToken.mockReturnValue('expired')
    api.mockRejectedValue(new Error('unauthorized'))
    await loadMe()
    expect(setToken).toHaveBeenCalledWith(null)
    expect(auth.user).toBeNull()
    expect(auth.loaded).toBe(true)
  })

title: clears the session even when logout fails
fullName: auth session clears the session even when logout fails
source:
it('clears the session even when logout fails', async () => {
    auth.user = user
    api.mockRejectedValue(new Error('offline'))
    await expect(logout()).rejects.toThrow('offline')
    expect(auth.user).toBeNull()
    expect(setToken).toHaveBeenCalledWith(null)
  })

title: uses a saved choice instead of the system theme
fullName: theme uses a saved choice instead of the system theme
source:
it('uses a saved choice instead of the system theme', () => {
    localStorage.setItem('studyroom_theme', 'dark')
    mockSystem(false)
    initTheme()
    expect(theme.followSystem).toBe(false)
    expect(theme.name).toBe('dark')
    expect(document.documentElement.dataset.theme).toBe('dark')
  })

title: follows the system when nothing valid is saved
fullName: theme follows the system when nothing valid is saved
source:
it('follows the system when nothing valid is saved', () => {
    localStorage.setItem('studyroom_theme', 'blue')
    mockSystem(true)
    initTheme()
    expect(theme.followSystem).toBe(true)
    expect(theme.name).toBe('dark')
    expect(document.documentElement.style.colorScheme).toBe('dark')
  })

title: toggle stores the choice and stops following the system
fullName: theme toggle stores the choice and stops following the system
source:
it('toggle stores the choice and stops following the system', () => {
    mockSystem(false)
    initTheme()
    toggleTheme()
    expect(theme.name).toBe('dark')
    expect(theme.followSystem).toBe(false)
    expect(localStorage.getItem('studyroom_theme')).toBe('dark')
    toggleTheme()
    expect(theme.name).toBe('light')
  })
